svg.title: CyRoot — Where Functions Meet Zero
svg.desc: Actual Newton tangents approach the zero of x cubed minus x minus two. A recorded Powell dogleg path crosses residual contours for a nonlinear system. This illustration shows convergence geometry, not a timing comparison.
